author: MarioNawfal
text:
🇵🇰 IF THE WORLD KEEPS TURNING A BLIND EYE, IMRAN KHAN MAY NO LONGER BE WITH US!

They couldn't break Imran Khan, so now his family fears Pakistani authorities are planning something much worse

His sister Aleema Khan has spent years fighting for a brother she is rarely allowed to see, and every time I speak to her, she is even more defiant 

In this conversation, Aleema describes what those months have looked like from the outside of a prison wall.

Imran has been held in almost total isolation for nearly ten months, with only five visits from family or lawyers in that entire time.

During that time he developed an eye infection.

For two weeks he told prison authorities he could not see from one eye, and no medical help came. By the time a doctor examined him, the damage was irreversible.

What frightens the family most is what Aleema believes is happening around him.

Medical information about hypertension has been deliberately leaked, while images of an increasingly old and frail Imran have begun circulating.

She believes a public image is being built, piece by piece, of a man whose health is naturally collapsing.

That is why the family now takes one of Imran's own warnings seriously: that he could die in custody the way Mohamed Morsi died in Egypt.

Aleema's argument is that Pakistan's establishment fears the millions of Pakistanis who still believe in what her brother represents far more than it fears the man himself.

And if they can neither release him nor break him, his family is left asking the darkest question of all. 

What are they prepared to do with him? 

@Aleema_KhanPK
